sentences.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission reviewed the Department of Transport's management of unlawful access to TRELIS, its licensing database.
sentences.support: The Commission undertook a thematic review of unlawful accesses to TRELIS

sentences.text: The review considered more than 100 reported incidents and examined 16 matters involving departmental staff and external users in detail.
sentences.support: Of the 16 matters selected, half involved DoT employees and half were external users of TRELIS.

sentences.text: The Commission found the department's inquiries inadequate and concluded that it had not properly recognised or managed unlawful access.
sentences.support: Investigation of and responses to unlawful use of TRELIS by DoT employees and external users of TRELIS were inadequate.

sentences.text: The Commission made four recommendations covering access policies, investigations, activity alerts and agreements with external users.
sentences.support: Review current TRELIS activity alerts to ensure they are contemporary, focused, and effective.

findings.quote: Having reviewed the identified incidents, the Commission considers that DoT actions taken were inadequate and the conclusions reached were not open to be made.
In all 16 matters reviewed by the Commission, DoT did not pursue adequate lines of enquiry, procedural fairness was not provided to all users and conclusions reached were not open to be made.
